bestBets.overview: MACCAS ANGEL chased home strongly and just missed here last start. Finds similar and although she is drawn wide sh e will go back and come with a late run. She can win. COURTING was well in the market at Seymour on debut but she found heavy ground and did nothing. Better coming to the synthetic. JENNI BAM BAM was similar on her debut when failed when asked on wet ground. She will be vast improver this campaign. ALL TOO SINGLE made some goood late ground when resuming here first-up. Strips fitter and the step out in distance is sure to suit.

raceTips.comment:
Macca's Angel is hard fit on the quick back up after she was unlucky not to win at this track and distance on Monday. After missing the start she raced wide without cover before hitting the line strongly only for the jockey to sit up on the line when she was beaten by a nose. 
Courting had jumped out well prior to her debut where she didn't handle the wet track. She's jumped out well again since and onto the synthetic surface it won't be any surprise to see her win. 
OIive Road went into the first up run without a jumpout and then raced four-wide without cover. He will strip much fitter and can roll forward and potentially lead or settle outside the leader if they go back to the tactics that worked last preparation. 
All Too Single hit the line strongly after missing the start first up and can be much closer if she begins with the field.

bestBets.overview: COSMIC SHOWER has been screaming out for maiden win. Started favourite here last start and just missed in driving finish. Placed in all three starts this time in and from inside gate she can go one better. COVERT MISSION was sent out favourite first-up but found a heavy track and was just one paced. Better on this surface. PHILLIP ISLAND made some late ground when in market first-up. He strips fitter for this while HIGHBROW is a debutant who has shown ability in jumpouts and expect she will have market support.

raceTips.comment:
This looks a strong maiden however I wouldn't be surprised to see the debutant Highbrow measure up. 
She jumped out well at Werribee under light riding and has jumped out well again since at Flemington, again under little pressure.
Phillip Island hit the line strongly first up behind a potentially smart winner. On that effort he looks suited rising in distance and he's capable of settling much closer. 
Cosmic Shower is fit and racing consistently well on this track. My concern given the price is this is potentially a stronger maiden. 
Covert Mission was beaten as favourite first up on a wet track and could easily bounce back on a firmer surface.

Paramount Plus has won his last (and only) two starts at the track. He's fit, in form and Eurell/Neindorf combination commands respect. He seems generous odds at $8 in early markets.

Blondeau hasn't won in more than four years however his recent form at the track is encouraging enough to suggest a win could be close. 
Fiery Deal resumes off a very quiet jumpout. His first up form has actually been pretty good in unsuitable races and it won't surprise to see him charging home late. 
Cashout resumes gelded off an encouraging jumpout and looks an obvious leading chance.
